title: Taking turns
examples: What do I do if my friend keeps playing with my toy?
How can I remember to wait my turn?
Can we use a clock to help us take turns?

explain.say: Taking turns means one person plays, then the next person plays. Everyone gets a go.
Sometimes you want the toy right now. Waiting can feel hard. That feeling is okay.

draw.text: Waiting can feel hard. That is okay.

explain.say: While you wait, you can watch, count slowly or take a slow breath. Your turn will come.
A timer can help. When the timer rings, the turn is over. Then you pass the toy on.

draw.text: When it rings, pass it on.

explain.say: To ask for a turn, use kind words. Say, Can I have a turn next, please?

draw.text: Can I have a turn next, please?

faq.q: What if I really want to play with a toy right now?
faq.a: It is okay to want things right away. You can take a big breath and remember to wait for your turn.
asks: What should I do when I want a toy?
How do I wait my turn?

faq.a: Sharing can feel hard sometimes, and that is okay. It lets everyone play together.
asks: Do I have to share everything?

faq.q: Why do we need a timer for playing?
faq.a: A timer helps us know when our turn is finished. It makes sure everyone gets a chance to play.
asks: How does a timer help us?
Can a clock help us take turns?

faq.q: What if my friend does not want to share?
faq.a: You can use your words to ask nicely for a turn. You can also ask a grown-up for help.
asks: What if my friend is selfish?

faq.q: Does waiting make me feel grumpy?
faq.a: Waiting can feel hard, and you may feel grumpy. Counting slowly can help your body feel calm.
asks: How do I feel when I wait?

facts: Taking turns means letting others use things too.
Waiting helps us practise being patient friends.
A timer can help us keep track of playtime.
Sharing toys makes playing more fun for everyone.

quiz.say: Aoife has the red crayon. You want it. Tap what to do.
quiz.show: 🖍️ Aoife is using the red crayon.
quiz.why: Asking with kind words is fair. Aoife can give you a turn when she is finished.

wrong.0: Grabbing takes the crayon from Aoife, and that can upset her.
wrong.2: Shouting can upset Aoife, so kind words work better.

quiz.say: Sam is on the slide. You are waiting. Tap what to do.
quiz.why: Counting slowly helps your body stay calm. Your turn will come soon.

wrong.1: Pulling Sam can hurt him, so wait for him to finish.
wrong.2: Shouting can upset Sam, so wait calmly for your turn.

quiz.say: The timer rings. Your turn is over. Tap what you do next.
quiz.why: The timer tells you the turn is over. Passing the toy on is fair.

wrong.0: The timer means it is the next person’s go now.
wrong.1: Hiding the toy means your friend misses a turn.
